'''Longships''' are large [[boats]] with a high sailing speed, a high amount of storage and average maneuverability. Their cost of construction makes Longships less than disposable. However, their significantly higher health and fast sailing speeds make them a decent upgrade from the Karve. Longships are reliable boats, able to store a large amount of cargo while boasting some of the best maneuverability, without being so large as to be cumbersome.

They travel 3.6–9.4 m/s with full sails, 3.6–6.7 m/s with half sails and 3.16 m/s when paddling.
== Specifications ==
* 1000 HP
* 22m long x 6m wide x ~11m air draft (height above the water)
* 4 seats plus pilot (currently, any number of people can hold fast. You are also able to hold fast to the bow of the ship.)
* 18 storage slots (cargo weight does not seem to affect handling or speed)
* Speed<ref>Tests with a strong wind are not fully accurate because of waves.</ref>
** Full sails
***100% tailwind: 9.5 m/s
***100% crosswind: 9.5 m/s
***100% cross-tailwind: 9.75 m/s
***100% head-crosswind: 6.2 m/s
***75% tailwind: 8.5 m/s
***75% crosswind: 8.6 m/s
***75% cross-tailwind: 8.7 m/s
***75% head-crosswind: 5.6 m/s
***50% tailwind: 7.45 m/s
***50% crosswind: 7.55 m/s
***50% cross-tailwind: 7.65 m/s
***50% head-crosswind: 4.95 m/s
***25% tailwind: 6.25 m/s
***5% tailwind: 5.04 m/s
** Half sails:
***100% tailwind: 6.7 m/s

***25% tailwind: 4.4 m/s
***5% tailwind: 3.6 m/s
** Paddling: 3.16 m/s
* 60m turning radius at top speed with full sail

== Notes ==
* Boats cannot be deconstructed with a hammer, but their resources drop when they are destroyed and can be recovered if a player is standing or swimming in range to pick them up before they sink.
* Longships can capsize from heavy waves during storms, though it is rare. Sail directly towards the waves at less than full sails to minimize the risk.

== Trivia ==
* Curiously, instead of real-life designs, the dragon head of the Longship in the game is based on the visage of Moorwens, a race of lizard-like quadrupedal aliens whose last surviving member served as the main antagonist of overrated 2008 sci-fi Viking film ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outlander_(film) Outlander]''.
